notes.title: Smol Update 2
notes.content:
- Couple of typos fixed.
- A reminder exclamation point was placed so that the assistant's letter will not be forgotten. (I know you skip reading it!)
- The government's tolerance is slightly higher when the opposition path is chosen.
- Minor visual improvements
- Improved Help / Tutorial
- If the Help / Tutorial is completed once, it does not open automatically when starting a new game.
- Fixed a bug that caused Anna to be in the starting squad on the first week.
- Fixed a bug that caused the employee's photo to remain in the popup news when the news was not given to the employee by force.

Good luck out there my dear editors.
